proposal.rationale: This partial overlay uses the detection-stage portion of the successful staggered development configuration as a joint setting. It raises the binary threshold to suppress weak clutter, keeps the oblique accumulator permissive, allows moderate oblique gaps, makes horizontal fallback more selective, and retains a bounded vertical threshold. The worked example reports only the joint outcome, so no individual parameter effect is assumed. Unfolding is omitted because stage1_unlocked is false.
